snippets.title: Set up a MinIO alias
snippets.description: Create a saved connection profile to a MinIO server
snippets.code: mc alias set myminio https://minio.example.com ACCESS_KEY SECRET_KEY

snippets.title: Set up a MinIO alias (using env vars)
snippets.description: Create a connection profile reading credentials from environment variables

snippets.title: List all IAM policies
snippets.description: Show all available IAM policies on the MinIO server

snippets.title: Create a custom IAM policy from JSON
snippets.description: Create a new IAM policy on MinIO from a local JSON file
snippets.code: mc admin policy create myminio my-policy-name /path/to/policy.json

snippets.title: Create a custom IAM policy (inline JSON)
snippets.description: Create a read-only policy for a specific bucket using an inline heredoc

snippets.title: Attach a policy to an AD user
snippets.description: Grant an IAM policy to a single Active Directory user by their LDAP DN
snippets.code:
mc admin policy attach myminio my-policy-name \
  --user "uid=jdoe,dc=example,dc=com"

snippets.title: Attach a policy to an AD group
snippets.description: Grant an IAM policy to all members of an Active Directory group
snippets.code:
mc admin policy attach myminio readwrite \
  --group "cn=data-analysts,ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com"

snippets.title: Detach a policy from an AD user
snippets.description: Revoke an IAM policy from a specific Active Directory user
snippets.code:
mc admin policy detach myminio my-policy-name \
  --user "uid=jdoe,dc=example,dc=com"

snippets.title: Detach a policy from an AD group
snippets.description: Revoke an IAM policy from an Active Directory group
snippets.code:
mc admin policy detach myminio readwrite \
  --group "cn=data-analysts,ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com"

snippets.title: Show policies attached to an AD user
snippets.description: List all IAM policies currently attached to a specific AD user

snippets.title: Show policies attached to an AD group
snippets.description: List all IAM policies currently attached to a specific AD group

snippets.title: Look up an AD user via LDAP
snippets.description: Query the LDAP directory to verify a user exists and see their policy mappings
snippets.code:
mc idp ldap policy entities myminio \
  --user "uid=jdoe,dc=example,dc=com"

snippets.title: Look up an AD group via LDAP
snippets.description: Query the LDAP directory to verify a group exists and see its policy mappings
snippets.code:
mc idp ldap policy entities myminio \
  --group "cn=data-analysts,ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com"
